_comment: Tier matrix + asset templates for feature-launch-playbook. Pure-reasoning composite: the AGENT generates each asset. This asset gates WHICH assets to produce by launch tier and what each must contain.

messaging_foundation.rule: Outcome-driven headline (not feature-driven), subhead (what + for whom), proof point, single CTA.

headline_examples.good: Find your best leads in seconds

asset_templates.changelog: Dated entry: what changed, who benefits, one-line how-to or link. All tiers.
asset_templates.email-announcement: Subject + preheader + body (outcome-led, one CTA). Tier 1-2.
asset_templates.linkedin-x3: 3 framings via create-linkedin-content (builder-story / product-launch / problem-first). Tier 1-2.
asset_templates.x-thread: Hook tweet + 3-6 mechanism/benefit tweets + CTA tweet via create-x-content. Tier 1-2.
asset_templates.in-app-banner: <=12-word headline + CTA button label + dismiss copy. Tier 1-2.
asset_templates.sales-enablement-one-pager: Positioning, before/after, objection handles, talk track. Tier 1 only.
